title: AI UGC Shoe Ads for Footwear Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn shoe photos into AI UGC video ads that show the pair in motion. Create fit checks, close-ups, and social clips in minutes without booking a model or shoot.
h1: AI UGC Shoe Ads for Footwear Brands
lead: Give shoppers a closer look at the shoes you sell. Turn a product photo into on-foot clips, fit checks, and ads in minutes.
card: Show a step, the fit, and the details that make each pair worth a closer look.

faq.q: Can I make a shoe ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear shoe photo, choose a scene, and create a short ad without filming the pair.

faq.q: Can the ad show my shoes on foot?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an on-foot scene so shoppers can see the pair being worn. Check the finished shape and details before posting.

faq.q: Which shoe details can I highlight?
faq.a: Show the profile, toe shape, sole edge, stitching, or material in close-up. Upload another angle when a detail is missing from your photo.

faq.q: Can I make ads for different shoe colors?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a photo of each color and create a separate version so the ad matches the pair you sell.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or film a shoe video?
faq.a: No. Start from the photos you already have and choose a ready-made scene. You can create more versions when a new style arrives.

faq.q: Can I use shoe videos on product pages and social media?
faq.a: Yes. Download the size that fits your product page, TikTok, Instagram, or another placement. Review each file before publishing.

faq.q: Can I run these clips as paid shoe ads?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the downloaded file in paid campaigns. Review the product and your wording before it goes live.

faq.q: How long can a shoe ad be, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds for 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. Starter is $24.50 for 200 credits; Pro is $35 for 300; Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make variations?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product link, then try a walking scene and a close-up from your shoe photos. Pick the version that shows the pair best.
